title: Tera Mehman Hon Shireen Tera Mehman Hon
body:
Tera Mehman Hon Shireen Tera Mehman Hon
Tera Mehman Hon Shiren Tera Mehman Hon ×3
<<DIVIDER>>
Tou Mujhe Jan Na Payi Yeh Mai Janta Hon
Tou Na Pehchanay Magar Mai Tujhe Pechanta hon
Tou Khatawar Nahin Shireen  Yeh Mai Janta Hon ×2
Hayee…..  tou Ne Is Haal Mai Kaab Phele Mujhe Dekha Hai
<<MINI>>
Bakhuda Jan Lei Mujh Ko Pehchan Lei
Tera Mehman Hon Shireen Tera Mehman Hon ×2
<<DIVIDER>>
Mai Salamat Rahon Mani Thi Tou Ne Yeh Mannat
Ho Gayi Khatam Zamane Se Yeh Teri Zehmat
Ghar Tere Ajj Mai Mehman Hova Iss Sorat ×2
Hayee…..Sar Mera Nok e Sina Jisam Karbobala
<<MINI>>
Bakhuda Jan Lei Mujh Ko Pehchan Lei
Tera Mehman Hon Shireen Tera Mehman Hon ×2
<<DIVIDER>>
Yad Shireen Tujhe Wo Zamana Ho Gha Mera
Sath Saye Ki Tarha Rehta Tha Nana Mera
Kaam Jibreil ka Tha Naaz Uthaney  Mera ×2
Hayee….. Ajj Beghor o Kafan Hai Jism Hai Maqtal Mai Para
<<MINI>>
Bakhuda Jan Lei Mujh Ko Pehchan Lei
Tera Mehman Hon Shireen Tera Mehman Hon ×2
<<DIVIDER>>
Tukre Tukre They Parey Ran Mai  Jisam Ke Pare
Lash Akbar Ki Utha Laye Na Himmat Hare
Hosla Dekh Ke Hairan They farishtey  Sarey ×2
Hayee…. Aik Mehman Pai Kiya Kiya hoye Na Zulm o Jafa
<<MINI>>
Bakhuda Jan Lei Mujh Ko Pehchan Lei
Tera Mehman Hon Shireen Tera Mehman Hon ×2
<<DIVIDER>>
Ya Ali Keh ke Di Maqtal Mai duhayie Maine
Asteen Kohniyon Tak Charhayie Maine
Youn Sina Sena-e-Akbar Se Nikali Maine ×2
Hayee….. Samne NazRon Ke Farzand  Ne Daam Tor Diya
<<MINI>>
Bakhuda Jan Lei Mujh Ko Pehchan Lei
Tera Mehman Hon Shireen Tera Mehman Hon ×2
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghar Tera Aya Hon Is Haal Mai Hairan Na Ho
Meri Mahman nawazi Mai Pareshan Na Ho
Bus Dua Kar Mere Jaisa Koi Mehman Na Ho ×2
Hayee….. Aise Aalam Mai Aye Na Kisi Ko Bhi Qaza
<<MINI>>
Bakhuda Jan Lei Mujh Ko Pehchan Lei
Tera Mehman Hon Shireen Tera Mehman Hon ×2
<<DIVIDER>>
Ask e Khoon Ajj Bhi Ankhon Se Rawah Hai Mesum
Q Na Ho Karti Hein Khud Fatima Zehra (as)  Matam
Kaak Uratey Hein Sar e Kuld Rasoul e Akraam ×2
Hayee….. Kaisa Pur Dard Hai Khursheed  Yeh Likha Nohay
